detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Epithalon (Epitalon)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C14H22N4O9
  • Molecular Weight: 390.35 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide composed of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. It is provided exclusively for in vitro laboratory research in qualified experimental settings. The compound is structurally characterized and utilized for analytical and experimental evaluation under controlled, non-clinical conditions. It is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

 

Research Applications:

Epithalon is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models

Storage and Handling:

  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory techniques during handling.

Product Specifications:

  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents

Compliance Notice:

Epithalon is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
